name: Private School
original_name: プライベートスクール
source: Private School is about a man trying to sneak into an all-women school so that he can cause mischief and possibly make it in bed with one of the girls that go there. It's a pretty standard sex comedy that uses the look/talk/move/etc. form of advancing the plot.
translation: 《Private School》讲述一名男子设法潜入女子学校，企图在那里胡作非为，甚至和某名女学生上床的故事。这是一部相当典型的性爱喜剧，通过“观察”“交谈”“移动”等指令推进剧情。
